purpose: Generate deterministic Markdown reports for AutomateThought.com newsletter packet runs.
determinism: High - derived Markdown must be stable for identical inputs.
constraints: Append-only report runs, canonical allowlisted JSON v1, deterministic derived Markdown, and superseding corrections.

product.problemStatement: Report operators need append-only AutomateThought.com packet processing without losing invalid or missing packet evidence.
product.targetUsers: Hermes operators, core maintainers, and downstream report consumers
product.whyNow: Reviewed M0-M5 gates are ready to become development governance.
product.expectedValue: Every report run produces unconditional Markdown and auditable SQLite rows.
product.solutionSummary: Build a local CLI data pipeline that ingests allowlisted JSON v1 packets, records valid-only child rows, and renders deterministic Markdown.
product.mvpScope: Ship append-only report run storage, unconditional Markdown output, packet validity accounting, and superseding corrections.
product.outOfScope: Collectors, remote APIs, and browser UI are deferred.
product.assumptions: Operators can provide packet JSON files on disk and use XDG data locations.
product.nonGoals: Do not build collectors, remote service integrations, or browser surfaces in the MVP.

governance.keyDecisions: Preserve the reviewed M0-M5 plan, keep authentication out of scope, and make canonical JSON v1 the public input contract.
governance.topRisks: Renderer drift could promote deferred collectors or corrupt AutomateThought.com into malformed concept tasks.
governance.mitigationPlans: Use structured finalizedContract milestones and semantic validation of generated development docs.
governance.contingencies: Stop finalization if generated docs contradict accepted decisions or deferred scope.
governance.remainingAcceptedRisks: Packet source quality remains non-gating for report run creation.

ownershipBoundaries: Hermes owns source packet production outside this repository.
Core owns canonical validation, run storage, and deterministic Markdown derivation.
Consumers own downstream reading of generated Markdown and JSON summaries.
invariants: Markdown is written unconditionally for every run.
Packet valid, invalid, and missing states are recorded but do not gate run creation.
Child rows are inserted only for valid packet items.
Corrections supersede previous facts without destructive rewrites.
Canonical allowlisted JSON v1 is the only accepted packet input format.
Derived Markdown is deterministic for identical stored inputs.

domainModel.name: ReportRun stores run id, source packet path, packet status, timestamps, and Markdown artifact path.
PacketFact stores child rows only when the packet is valid.
Correction records superseding changes while preserving prior facts.

dataModel.name: XDG data directory contains the SQLite database.
XDG state directory contains generated Markdown and run logs.
Canonical packet JSON v1 fields are allowlisted before persistence.

publicContracts.name: Canonical allowlisted JSON v1 packet format

milestones.name: Repository And CLI Baseline
milestones.goal: Create the local Python CLI skeleton and verification commands.

tasks.text: Create the report-pipeline entrypoint and help output.
Wire build, run, and unit test commands.

milestones.name: Append-Only Run Storage
milestones.goal: Persist every report run in XDG-local SQLite.

tasks.text: Create SQLite tables for report runs, packet facts, and corrections.
Guarantee report run inserts are append-only.

gates.name: A second run inserts a new row instead of mutating the first.
SQLite file lands under the XDG data directory.

milestones.name: Packet Validity Accounting
milestones.goal: Record valid, invalid, and missing packet states without gating run creation.

tasks.text: Classify packet state as valid, invalid, or missing.
Insert child rows only for valid packet items.

gates.name: Invalid packet still creates a report run.
Missing packet still creates a report run.
Invalid and missing packets create no child fact rows.

milestones.name: Deterministic Markdown Derivation
milestones.goal: Render unconditional Markdown for every stored run.

tasks.text: Render deterministic Markdown from stored run state.
Assert identical stored inputs produce identical Markdown.

gates.name: Valid, invalid, and missing packet runs each write Markdown.

tasks.text: Preserve prior fact rows when corrections are added.

gates.name: Correction lookup returns the latest superseding value.

milestones.name: Release Verification Packet
milestones.goal: Prove the full local pipeline with fixtures and governance evidence.

tasks.text: Run valid, invalid, and missing packet fixtures end to end.
Record milestone evidence in ROADMAP and runtime verification docs.

gates.name: All fixture runs produce expected SQLite state.
All fixture runs produce deterministic Markdown.
Deferred scope remains excluded from active implementation.
